PR identity & forks.question: Where can a PR head come from?
Cross-fork head rules?
PR identity & forks.answer: Head must be fork of this repo or same-repo branch; base on this repo

PR identity & forks.question: Updating head after open?
PR identity & forks.answer: Allow force-push head and change base; mark outdated line comments

Review model.question: Who can approve / request changes?
Review model.answer: Write+ (GitHub classic); author cannot Approve own PR

Review model.question: Requested reviewers / merge gate?
Review model.answer: Optional requests only; no required-approval merge gate until Phase 13

Line comments & diff UX.question: Diff / comments UX?
Line comments & diff UX.answer: Conversation|Commits|Files; unified+split; line+multiline comments; resolve threads; outdated on force-push

Merge strategies.question: Merge methods?
Merge strategies.answer: merge commit / squash / rebase; per-repo enable toggles; defaults all on

Closing keywords.question: When do fixes/closes apply?
Closing keywords.answer: On merge to default branch from PR body + commits; replace pr_stub with real PRs

UI chrome & list.question: Chrome / list?
UI chrome & list.answer: Pulls tab in layout RepoChrome; Open/Closed/All + filters; compare → open PR
